test_title: PYST 52: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends Priya, Rahul, Suresh, Tina, and Varun are sitting on a circular table facing the center. Varun, who is sitting to the immediate left of Rahul, is also second to the right of Tina. Suresh is not sitting next to Varun. Who is sitting second to the left of Rahul?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Varun, who is sitting to the immediate left of Rahul, is also second to the right of Tina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14f7e80a3710f02f5e68119e63456ac7c512443dbc449bfaaf0c2a62fcc37149.png] 

2) Suresh is not sitting next to Varun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2860c4e672eb4c31d4ab1a15487cd8c64fe052bbc83f5e0121997f90de359b96.png] 

Here, we can see that Priya is sitting second to the left of Rahul.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Priya"**.
